name: Reen Rebecca
bio:
Reen Rebecca is a highly proficient tattoo artist, known for her expertise in geometric and fineline designs that illustrate her attention to detail and artistic finesse. Operating from a private studio in Kota Kinabalu, Reen maintains a strict appointment-only schedule, ensuring that each client receives a personalized and focused tattooing experience. Her professional approach is complemented by an immaculate work environment, prioritizing hygiene and cleanliness to guarantee the well-being and satisfaction of her clientele.
